description: Defines the URLRequestThrottlerEntry class, which manages request throttling logic including exponential back-off and sliding window request counting for URL requests within the Chromium project.

classes.name: URLRequestThrottlerEntry
classes.description: Manages request throttling, including back-off and sliding window request counting, for URL requests.

methods.name: ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Determines if a request should be rejected based on throttling rules.

methods.name: ReserveSendingTimeForNextRequest
methods.description: Reserves a time slot for the next request, considering back-off timing.

methods.name: GetExponentialBackoffReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the back-off period ends, allowing requests to proceed.

methods.name: UpdateWithResponse
methods.description: Updates throttling state based on the response status code.

methods.name: ReceivedContentWasMalformed
methods.description: Handles malformed response content, potentially increasing back-off.
